bullets: Certification and documentation according to ATEX 2014/34/EU and applicable EU norms ensures legal compliance
Certification of entire trucks for zone 1/21, and not just the individual electrical assemblies ensures maximum level of safety
Passive protection concept enables zone 2/22 trucks to operate in explosive atmospheres, no shut-down required
Protection of electrical equipment and protection against mechanically generated sparks, unacceptably high temperatures and dangerous electrostatic discharge
Intuitive controls can be easily operated with both hands
Ergonomically shaped tiller head
Multifunction display shows all important truck information
Compact chassis and small turning circle for optimum manoeuvrability in tight spaces
Creep speed option for precise handling in tight spaces
Booster function for short-term increase in power to aid travelling over uneven floors or on inclines
Long tiller maintains safety distance between operator and machine
Smart bumper and low chassis prevent foot injuries
Automatic electromagnetic brake and belly switch for reduced accident risk
Automatic parking brake for safety on loading ramps or inclines
Constant monitoring of ATEX-relevant safety values and wearing parts
Truck access control by PIN code or RFID
Robust, temperature monitored AC motor designed for a long service life
CAN bus architecture for easy access to all truck data
Optional data transmission unit for remote diagnostics and software updates
Linde Ex-Monitoring app for quick and efficient diagnosis of ATEX-relevant values
Rapid access to all truck data for performance parameter settings, troubleshooting and preventative maintenance
Central 24/7 provision of standard and ATEX spare parts
Wide service network with certified technicians
